purpose: Conceptual, fictional, text-free use-case thumbnails. Shared neutral visuals for English and Spanish README tables.

prompts.police: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE original 16:9 landscape photographic thumbnail for a professional software README. It must remain understandable at 160 x 90 pixels: two or three large visual elements, tight coherent composition, no tiny details. Premium documentary product photography, real human proportions, dark navy and cool blue palette, natural soft light, subtle blue technology accents. Entirely fictional adult people, no celebrities or real personal data. ZERO text anywhere: no captions, letters, numerals, logos, watermarks, readable documents, badges or UI text. Any screen uses abstract interface shapes and portraits only. No cartoon, clay render, calendar, standalone object still life or decorative infographic. This is a clearly illustrative concept photo, not a real app screenshot. Opaque background. A fictional police caseworker in a plain dark navy uniform wearing black smart glasses reviews an authorized person's case on an Android tablet in a neutral records office. A second fictional adult person's portrait is visible in a simple candidate card on the tablet, with a restrained blue face bounding box and a second abstract record card. The caseworker's face and tablet are the dominant subjects. No weapons, arrest, military imagery, emblems or dramatic crime scene.
